# Enterprise TaskFlow  
A task management platform built with React and Node.js, designed for large-scale enterprise workflows. Prioritizes scalability, security, and seamless integration with existing systems.  

---

## Badges  
[![GitHub](https://badgen.net/badge/github/OmarFarooq/Enterprise-TaskFlow/green)](https://github.com/OmarFarooq/Enterprise-TaskFlow)  
[![npm](https://badgen.net/badge/npm/1.0.0/green)](https://npmjs.com/package/enterprise-taskflow)  
[![Docker](https://badgen.net/badge/docker/2.5/green)](https://hub.docker.com/r/enterprise-taskflow)  

---

## Getting Started / Installation  
1. Clone the repo: `git clone https://github.com/OmarFarooq/Enterprise-TaskFlow.git`  
2. Navigate to the project root: `cd Enterprise-TaskFlow`  
3. Install dependencies: `npm install`  
4. Set up environment variables: Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and update PostgreSQL credentials.  
5. Start the app: `docker-compose up -d`  

---

## Usage / Examples  
To create a task:  
**API Call**:  
```bash
POST /api/tasks  
{ "title": "Review Q3 report", "assignee": "john.doe@company.com" }
```  
**React Component**:  
```jsx
<CreateTaskForm onSubmit={handleCreateTask} />  
```  
Tasks are filtered by priority and assigned to users via role-based access.  

---

## API Reference  
- `GET /api/tasks` – Fetch all tasks (paginated)  
- `POST /api/tasks` – Create a new task  
- `PUT /api/tasks/:id` – Update task status  
- `DELETE /api/tasks/:id` – Archive task  
Authentication: Bearer token via `Authorization` header.  

---

## Testing  
Run unit tests: `npm test`  
End-to-end tests use Cypress. Coverage report generated in `coverage/` directory.  
GitLab CI pipelines automate testing on PRs.  

---

## Deployment  
Deploy with Docker and Kubernetes. Terraform provisions cloud resources.  
Production setup includes PostgreSQL 14, Redis for caching, and NGINX reverse proxy.
